title: ProfCucumber's Epic Modpack
description: Have you ever played Minecraft and thought "I need more"? This pack is for you! It adds a ton of mods to enhance your Minecraft experience without breaking the game.
body:
This modpack has a ton of mods, resource packs, and data packs for an enjoyable Minecraft experience. It's the perfect pack for those who like exploration, discovery, and adventure.
With this pack, you can shoot an iceologer with an assult rifle while eating a hambuger, 
and who wouldn't love that?

The one thing that this mod specifically doesn't include that a lot of other packs like this
do is Create. Although I do enjoy this mod, I feel it to be a little bit too complicated
for this pack. 

What this pack DOES add is planes, guns, waystones, a minimap, a bunch of structures, 
artifacts, corpses for when you die, grappling hooks, backpacks, 
an inventory sorter, new mobs, realistic physics (Physics Mod Pro)*, 
furniture, better tree chopping, new armor sets you can craft, 
a ton of performance mods, more food, a new dimension (the Aether),
better world gen and so much more. 

It doesn't come with shaders by default, but you can install them through the Resourcify interface. 

Giving credit where credit is due: 
Vanilla tweaks is a resource pack I use that provides plenty of QOL tweaks in one great customizable resource pack. You can make your own [here](https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/resource-packs/). 

Unfourtunately, because of copyright issues, I cannot include physics mod pro in the modpack.
However, if you would like to download it yourself, you can get it right [here](https://www.patreon.com/posts/physics-mod-pro-89202866).
All you have to do is download the mod for forge 1.19.2, open downloads 
on file explorer, then go to Modrinth and click "Open Folder". 
If you have two windows of File Explorer open, you can easily drag the 
physics mod pro into the "mods" folder for the profile.
